To resolve the issue with your database restore taking hours, calculate the total possible connections as pool size multiplied by maximum instances, and compare it against your plan's connection limit [DOC-PERF-003]. If it exceeds the limit, reduce the per-instance pool size rather than raising the limit. Look for queries that hold a transaction open across a network call to another service, which is the most common cause of leaks of this kind [DOC-PERF-003]. Consider a connection proxy if the instance count must remain high, so that pooling happens once rather than per instance [DOC-PERF-003]. Also, allow roughly ten minutes per hundred gigabytes for the restore, and considerably longer where the instance is also under load [DOC-DATA-002]. Verify the restored data before switching traffic, and keep the original instance until that verification is complete [DOC-DATA-002].
